read_open_loop_trajectory: read an open loop trajectory CSV file using mps.read_open_loop_trajectory
read_closed_loop_trajectory: read a closed loop trajectory CSV file using mps.read_closed_loop_trajectory
read_global_point_cloud: read a global point cloud from a CSV or GZIP file using mps.read_global_point_cloud
read_eyegaze: read eye gaze data from a CSV file using mps.read_eyegaze and access vergence fields
read_hand_tracking_results: read hand tracking results from a CSV file using mps.hand_tracking.read_hand_tracking_results
